steps.text: 1. The author opens the "Publish" step in the Studio, the "Offline download price" box, enters a price and presses "Save price". E1.

exceptions.text: E1. Invalid price (negative, fractional, under 1,000 or over 50,000,000) → 400; not the author → 403.

steps.text: 2. The system (Tour) only stores the price: the tour status does not change and the tour is not sent for review again; it returns the price, the number of sales and the revenue.
3. The Tourist opens the details of a priced public tour.
4. The system replaces the download section with a "Buy the tour to download" box (price, "Listening online stays free") and checks whether the Tourist has already bought it. A1, A2, A3.
6. The system creates a "Pending" order (amount = current price), asks MoMo to create a payment signed with HMAC SHA256 and returns the payment link. E2, E3, E4.

exceptions.text: E2. Free tour → 400; the author buys their own tour → 400; the tour is no longer public → 404.
E3. Already bought → 409; the client reloads the status and shows the download section.
E4. MoMo keys not configured, or MoMo refuses / does not answer → 503 "MoMo payment is temporarily unavailable"; the order becomes "Failed".

steps.text: 7. The browser goes to the MoMo payment page.
8. The Tourist pays on the MoMo page (wallet, ATM or a sandbox test card). A4.
9. MoMo sends an IPN to Tour; the system checks the signature and the amount, then sets the order to "Paid". E5.

exceptions.text: E5. IPN with a wrong signature, partnerCode or amount → 400, order unchanged; unknown order → 404.

steps.text: 10. MoMo sends the Tourist back to the result page; the page asks for the order status every 2 seconds (at most 1 minute), and Tour queries MoMo itself while the order is pending. A5.
11. The system shows "Payment successful" and a "Back to the tour to download" button.
12. The Tourist goes back to the tour page and downloads it as in UC#03.
13. The system checks the right to download (author, or a paid order) and returns the offline package. E6. A6, A7, A9.

exceptions.text: E6. Downloading a paid tour package while not signed in → 401; signed in but not bought → 402.
E7. Viewing the history while not signed in → 401; the admin transactions page with a non-admin account → 403; invalid filter → 400.

steps: A1. Free tour (price 0): no buy box, the "Download to listen offline" section as in UC#03.
A2. Not signed in: the box shows the price and a "Sign in to buy" button; after signing in the Tourist comes back to the tour page.
A3. The author or a Tourist who has bought it: shows "Your tour" / "You bought this tour" and the normal download section.
A4. Payment failed or cancelled by the Tourist: the order becomes "Failed", the result page says the payment did not go through, with a "Back to the tour" button; the Tourist can buy again.
A5. MoMo has not confirmed after 1 minute: the page shows "MoMo has not confirmed the payment yet" with a "Check again" button.
A6. An itinerary with a place from an unbought paid tour: downloading the itinerary package is refused with 402 until those tours are bought.
A7.1. The Tourist opens Account → "Transaction history".
A7.2. The system lists every order of the account (at most 50, newest first): tour, amount, status, time, order id, MoMo id; a pending order has a "Check again" button. E7.
A8. The tour already has sales: the price box shows the "Orders sold" list (buyer shortened to 6 characters, date, amount).
A9.1. The admin opens the admin area → "Transactions".
A9.2. The system shows the total collected and the number of successful orders, and the list of every order (status filter, 20 orders per page); the buyer links to the account page (UC#21). E7.
